The key is {@code normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or 12 * empty)}: 13 *

Because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household (same 23 * {@code householdId}) with different telephones have different keys and are both allowed; only an 24 * exact full-key match counts as a duplicate. 25 * 26 *

Centralised here so {@link CheckOwnerIdentityUnique} (which rejects collisions) and the owner 27 * mapper (which returns the key) cannot disagree on how it is derived. 28 */ 29 public final class OwnerIdentity { 30 31 private OwnerIdentity() { 32 } 33 34 /** The identity key of an existing owner, derived from its stored fields. */ 35 public static String of(Owner owner) { 36 return key(owner.getTelephone(), owner.getEmail(), owner.getHouseholdId()); 37 } 38 39 /** 40 * The identity key for the given parts: {@code normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + 41 * '|' + (householdId or empty)}. 42 */ 43 public static String key(String telephone, String email, String householdId) { 44 return OwnerTelephone.toE164OrRaw(telephone) + "|" + normalizeEmail(email) + "|" 45 + (householdId == null ?         status:

    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message

          type: string

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must be one
            of MR, MRS, MS or DR, and is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and
            returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 200'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits
            and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it (computed against the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already has the
            same last name and postcode (same household); such a declared household member
            is also not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in customerCode, derived at read time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household:
                the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so every owner with the same last name
                and postcode derives the same id automatically. Null for an owner with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty).
                A create request is rejected with 409 when its whole identityKey equals an
                existing owner's, or when it shares an existing owner's household (same last
                name and postcode) without declaring 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shared an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode but with a different telephone at the time
                it was created; false otherwise. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode (with a different telephone) at creation time. Null when
                'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation
                time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or
                more members (counted at creation), and +3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at read time from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, derived at read time as the IANA name for the
                owner's region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region
                has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' computed
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time; the raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

All tests pass and the build is green. Here's a summary of the change — owner deletion is now a soft-delete.

## What I changed

**1. `Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`)
Added a `deleted` boolean column (default `false`) with `isDeleted()`/`setDeleted()`. A newly created owner is `false`.

**2. Delete pipeline** (`rest/function/owner/DeleteOwner.java`)
Replaced the hard `ownerRepository.delete(owner)` with a soft-delete: set `deleted = true` and `save`, retaining the row. The `DELETE.yml` pipeline (load → delete → respond 204) is unchanged — it still returns 2xx, and `GET /api/owners/{id}` still loads the row (now with `deleted: true`).

**3. Create-time duplicate/identity checks**
- `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique` (the blocking 409 guard) now skips soft-deleted owners, so a normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only match is deleted.
- `AssignPossibleDuplicate` (the soft-duplicate flag) also skips deleted owners, per the spec's "duplicate and identity checks must ignore deleted owners."

**4. API contract** (`openapi.yml`)
Added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` schema. The generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct maps it automatically, so GET responses expose `deleted`.

**5. Schemas** (`db/hsqldb`, `db/h2`, `db/mysql`, `db/postgres`)
Added a `deleted` column (NOT NULL, default false) to the `owners` table. Tests run on hsqldb; the others were updated for consistency.
